body.text: How do LASIK, ReLEx SMILE and No-Touch PRK differ in recovery?

LASIK, ReLEx SMILE, and No-Touch PRK achieve comparable long-term visual acuity, yet their short-term recovery timelines differ sharply because of how each treats the corneal surface. LASIK and SMILE typically restore functional vision within 24 to 48 hours, whereas PRK requires three to five days of surface healing and sharper light sensitivity.

Clinical comparisons published in [The Ophthalmologist](https://theophthalmologist.com/issues/2025/articles/august/lasik-vs-smile-vs-prk/) note that SMILE uses a small keyhole incision without creating a corneal flap, and a [2025/2026 NIH PMC clinical review](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12755589/) reports better early corneal nerve sensitivity and lower dry-eye scores after SMILE than after LASIK. Because No-Touch PRK removes the outer epithelium, patients traveling for PRK should plan extra recovery nights in Istanbul before boarding a return flight.
Why is a comprehensive corneal topography exam required before confirming eligibility?

No ethical clinic can confirm your surgical technique from a glasses prescription sent by email. An in-person corneal topography and tomography scan maps both front and back corneal curvature and thickness, screening out hidden keratoconus or thin corneas that raise the risk of post-surgical ectasia.

The [U.S. FDA LASIK candidacy guide](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/lasik/when-lasik-not-me) and [FDA LASIK surgery checklist](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/lasik/lasik-surgery-checklist) warn that unstable prescriptions, severe dry eye, or insufficient corneal tissue can make LASIK unsafe. Contact lens wearers must switch to glasses well before arrival—often one week for soft lenses and longer for rigid lenses—so the cornea returns to its natural shape before measurement. If your ophthalmologist declines LASIK after scanning, your itinerary must stay flexible enough to pivot to PRK, SMILE, or no surgery at all.
How many days in Istanbul are needed for Day-1 post-op check-up?

For uncomplicated LASIK or SMILE, plan at least three full nights in Istanbul so your surgeon can examine corneal flap position or incision healing under a slit lamp the morning after surgery. Leaving the same evening skips the primary safety check used to catch early displacement or inflammation.

Guidance from the [American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO)](https://www.aao.org/eye-health/ask-ophthalmologist-q/does-piloting-long-haul-flight-affect-lasik-if-it-) confirms that surgeons routinely require a next-day post-operative visit before clearing travel. body.text: When can you fly and use screens after laser eye surgery?

Cabin pressure itself does not harm a healing cornea after LASIK or SMILE, so many surgeons clear short-haul flights 24 to 48 hours after a clean Day-1 exam. However, low-humidity airplane cabins accelerate tear evaporation, making frequent preservative-free lubricating drops essential during every hour aloft.

The [AAO laser surgery recovery guide](https://www.aao.org/eye-health/treatments/laser-surgery-recovery) advises resting your eyes during the first 24 hours, avoiding eye rubbing, and following your prescribed antibiotic and anti-inflammatory drop timetable strictly. Most LASIK and SMILE patients resume light phone or laptop work within 24 to 48 hours using the 20-20-20 break rule, while PRK patients typically need several days of audio-only rest before screens feel comfortable.

faq.q: Can I have my exam and LASIK eye surgery in Istanbul on the same day?
faq.a: Some clinics combine morning diagnostics with afternoon surgery if you have stayed out of contact lenses long enough, though splitting screening (Day 1) and treatment (Day 2) reduces rush and gives you time to review consent forms calmly.

faq.q: How early should I stop wearing contact lenses before flying to Istanbul?
faq.a: Most ophthalmologists ask patients to stop soft contact lenses 7 to 14 days before corneal topography and hard or toric lenses 3 to 4 weeks prior. Always confirm exact timing with your chosen clinic.

faq.q: What if my corneal scan shows I am not eligible for LASIK?
faq.a: Your ophthalmologist may recommend ReLEx SMILE, No-Touch PRK, an implantable collamer lens, or advise against surgery entirely. Because ITO is paid a flat client fee rather than clinic commissions, we never pressure you to proceed.

faq.q: Can I sightsee in Istanbul right after laser eye surgery?
faq.a: Keep the first 24 hours strictly indoors in a dim room. After a clear Day-1 check-up, gentle outdoor walks with wraparound UV sunglasses are usually comfortable, avoiding dusty sites, hammams, and swimming pools.

faq.q: What documents should I receive before leaving the eye hospital?
faq.a: Request your pre-operative corneal topography printouts, laser treatment parameters, post-op drop schedule in English, and your surgeon's direct follow-up instructions for your home optometrist.
